newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips resume surge, Dow up 140 points.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips resume surge, Dow up 140 points.

text.p: U.S. large cap stocks widened their already sharp gains in late afternoon, powering the Dow industrials to a rally that briefly exceeded 150 points.
At the height of its afternoon advance, the Dow reached 6817, up 157 points for the session. It soon edged off its highs, however, steadying at 6800, up 140 points.
Even as the Dow pushed to its sharpest gains, the broader market remained mixed, with investors showing a clear preference for large cap stocks.
Breadth on the NYSE was modestly positive, with advancers holding a seven-to-five edge. On the AMEX and Nasdaq, however, losers maintained their lead over advancers.
